control.correspondence: matched_control_group is carried verbatim from the integer corpus
control.rule: control = arithmetic mean over matched_control_group vehicle rows, each normalized on its own selected-axis library total

normalization.denominator: selected gene axis G_5000, before CP10K and natural log1p
normalization.library_total: sum of the profile's selected G_5000 integer counts (int64)

alias.recipe: Stream bounded integer corpus batches; select G_5000 in ascending original gene_index; sum selected counts in int64; normalize every row independently with natural log1p(CP10K); average normalized matched vehicles for control; delta = X - control. Publish float32.

control_rule: full-view control; only the label is pooled, delta_kind=pooled

environment.data_access: offline; reads the pinned integer corpus, the G_5000 axis and the accepted view-5k release in bounded windows
environment.resource_contract: one heavy job at a time under the repository caps; OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; peak RSS recorded by the driver

label_source.control_rule: normalize-of-sum over the union of the members' matched_control_group vehicle counts (never a mean of normalized values)
label_source.recipe: Sum the members' retained G_5000 integer counts per condition (int64), normalize the sum on its own selected-axis total; pool the union of the members' matched control groups' vehicle counts the same way; delta = X - control.
label_source.transfer: treated row delta = the delta layer of the merge row whose (cell_line, drug_parent_inchikey, dose_um) equals the row's condition

pooled_label.transport: row-aligned float32 .npy; treated rows carry their condition's merge delta; X/control aliased to the accepted full payload digests; delta is not X - control for treated rows by design
pooled_label.vehicle_rule: vehicle row: the full view's exact X - control (a vehicle row has no condition)

recipe: Keep the full view's rows, X and control; replace each treated profile's delta by its condition's merge-recipe pooled delta; publish only the delta payload.
